definitions.gloss: rental room; room available for hire
definitions.explanation: A room that is rented out for temporary use, such as meeting rooms, event spaces, or rooms in commercial buildings available for lease.

examples.japanese: {貸室|かししつ}⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{貸室|かししつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: To use a rental room for a meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{貸室|かししつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{借|か}りられる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: This building has three rental rooms that can be booked by the hour.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{貸|か}し→貸し：02578_kashi⟧ (lending, renting out) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). Often seen on signs outside buildings advertising available rental space. The ⟦{貸|か}し→貸し：02578_kashi⟧〜 prefix is productive for things available to rent: ⟦{貸|か}し→貸し：02578_kashi⟧{部屋|べや}, ⟦{貸|か}し{会議室|かいぎしつ}→貸し会議室：26518_kashikaigishitsu⟧, ⟦{貸|か}し→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦スタジオ→スタジオ：11583_sutajio⟧, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貸室|かししつ}あり: rooms available for rent (sign language)
- {貸室|かししつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧: to rent a room
- {貸室|かししつ}{料金|りょうきん}: rental room rate
- {時間貸|じかんが}し: hourly rental

RELATED {貸|か}し〜 COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{貸|か}し→貸し：02578_kashi⟧{部屋|べや}: rented room (residential)
- ⟦{貸|か}し{会議室|かいぎしつ}→貸し会議室：26518_kashikaigishitsu⟧: rental meeting room
- ⟦{貸|か}し→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦スタジオ→スタジオ：11583_sutajio⟧: rental studio
- ⟦{貸|か}し→貸し：02578_kashi⟧⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧: rental costumes/clothes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦レンタル→レンタル：11194_rentaru⟧⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧: rental space — the modern katakana equivalent, often used for online booking platforms
- ⟦{貸|か}し→貸し：02578_kashi⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: rented room — more residential, like a room in a shared house
